exposure: Short-term variation (STV) in fetal heart rate
Doppler parameters (umbilical artery PI MoM, middle cerebral artery PI MoM, cerebroplacental ratio MoM)
Neonatal outcome (5-minute Apgar score < 7, neonatal acidosis)
Middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (MCA PI)
Mode of delivery (Cesarean section due to fetal distress, emergency cesarean section, vaginal delivery)
finding: Doppler indices, particularly UA PI, assessed close to delivery in low-risk term fetuses showed a moderate association with adverse neonatal outcomes, while STV did not.
mod_finding: UA PI was significantly higher in fetuses delivered by cesarean section due to fetal distress and emergency cesarean section.
